caseTitle: structures: seven renderers, rest urgency, timers, coaching, effort, swap, finish

observations.text: A persisted seven-structure prescription started through start_session; the clock is Playwright's, advanced and paused so urgency and timing are observed at exact points.
Standard: shell, section, block and set form are sibling cards; fields and labels inside; Session time is a labelled non-live timer card.
Paused at two clock points six seconds apart, Session time advanced by six and the rest counted down by six: one wall clock drives both.
Rest low state: the card takes the timer-low role, digits cross colour over 0.4s in four steps, the card dims to 80% on the 4s two-step pulse, and no glow is added to the timer.
Coaching loading beside an urgent rest: the rest pulse holds the one interface loop and the loading region is stilled but still busy.
Coaching: cues, regression and the note field are ruled sub-groups with their labels inside one card, never a card in a card.
Under reduced motion the urgent rest keeps its words, digits and low colours; the pulse and every other animation stop.
EMOM low state: the shipped TimerDisplay is its own card beside the block card, steps its colour over 0.4s and pulses to 80% on the one loop, with no extra glow.
Finish workout stays inside the 390x320 short viewport on the last section (TASK-040's recorded overflow condition, now executed).
A failed completion keeps the session active behind its dialog; Finish again completes the stored session and lands on Summary.

dispositions.reason: No generic pause exists in the product: the rest is extended (Add 30s) or skipped, and timed blocks start and finish. "Paused" is pictured as the clock held at exact points, not as a pause control.
